title: Record surfaces that know only an object's name still show the base package's translation of a renamed object (related list, reference rail, packaged-actions table)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Filed by the `domain:ui#3` seat from the out-of-scope findings of #30390's card thread (os-dev-report 6658782766), whose PR #30475 makes record pages, forms, drawers and preview cards draw the served object label as given.

## Observed

After PR #30475, three places still name an object only through the client catalog, so a `.custom` extension's rename of an object is lost there and the base package's translation shows:

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail` record-reference-rail (two `objectPluralLabel` calls) and record-related-list name a related object by `humanize(objectName)` through the catalog only. No served object definition is in hand at those sites.
- `PackagedActionsSection` reads its object list with a bare `fetchObjectMetadata` fetch that does not send the session's `Accept-Language`. Drawing that served label as given would show the browser's language, so the table's object column keeps the catalog-first order.

## Wanted

- The related list and reference rail name a related object by its served label (and served plural for lists) when the server serves one, falling back to the catalog only when none is served, the same rule as `servedObjectLabel` / `servedObjectPluralLabel` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/servedObjectLabel.ts`.
- The packaged-actions object read sends the session's language, then its object column draws the served label the same way.

## Serial

Start after PR #30475 lands.

Blocked-by: #30475
Refs: #30390, #30311
Dedupe words: related list humanize object label, reference rail plural label served, packaged actions object label locale, meta object bare fetch accept-language
